commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
90+4' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
90+3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
90+3' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short.
90+2' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdon Prats (Mallorca) replacing Vedat Muriqi.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Copete (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch so that Manu Morlanes can be given a rest.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Dominik Greif easily deals with the threat. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
89' The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
89' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
89' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
87' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
86' Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.

86' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
85' The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
85' A pass by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Juan Martinez Munuera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
82' Substitution. Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Andoni Gorosabel.

82' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
82' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) pounces on a loose ball from the corner kick and fires from the edge of the box. His brilliant effort smashes against the crossbar.
81' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle as Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
78' Dominik Greif (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
77' An attempted cross from Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
75' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has a goal ruled out for offside!
74' The corner kick from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
73' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.

72' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
71' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
70' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) replaces Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
68' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch for Robert Navarro.
64' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Nico Williams, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
63' The resulting corner from Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
63' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Ath Bilbao have a corner.
62' Good movement by Johan Mojica (Mallorca), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
61' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
59' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
57' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Gorka Guruzeta and he is replaced by Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao).
57' Substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) on for Oihan Sancet.
57' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez Munuera who sees an offensive foul.
55' The attendance is 19797.

53' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
51' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
50' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

48' That's a well-taken pass by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
48' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
47' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
46' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has made a change at the break. Dani Vivian has come on in place of Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao).
46' Half-time substitution. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is replaced by Antonio Sanchez.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
45+5' The resulting corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) comes to nothing.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
45+2' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' The Ath Bilbao players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
45' The goal for Ath Bilbao is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
45' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is quickest to pounce on a rebound and steers a powerful header past the helpless goalkeeper, into the middle of the net.
42' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

39' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
37' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is given a yellow card.
37' The foul by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was seen by Juan Martinez Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

36' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Free kick. Mallorca will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
35' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
33' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball onto Oihan Sancet, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
31' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
30' Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
30' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
28' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dominik Greif, who smothers the ball.
26' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Juan Martinez Munuera immediately signals a free kick.
26' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
25' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cyle Larin leaves the pitch and Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) comes on.
25' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
23' The main referee, Juan Martinez Munuera, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is given a yellow card for dissent.
23' Samu Costa (Mallorca) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
22' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul.
18' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
17' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Gorka Guruzeta, but he puts too much power on the pass.
12' The ref seems satisfied following his VAR review and the yellow card for Samu Costa (Mallorca) stands. Play continues.
11' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Samu Costa (Mallorca)! Let's see what he decides.
10' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
9' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
5' A pass by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Julen Agirrezabala leaps like a salmon to deny him.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) heads on.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
